scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. Every interviewer submits their own scorecard before they can read anyone else's, even the hiring manager.

But the useful part is what broke. The CSV export counted recommendations, which could reveal hidden scorecards. And data retention wiped a candidate's phone number while another application was still open.
Greenhouse doesn't publish prices. All three plans say get a demo. If you hire for a few roles at a time, you mostly need the board, honest scorecards, and a decision on every candidate.
